variant.reason: Astroray keeps the radiance 1/eta^2 on light crossing the glass boundary (pbrt-v4 radiance mode, Veach thesis 5.2) and Cycles has none, so emission inside the glass reads 1/n^2 darker in Astroray. The reference scales the Emission strength by 1/n^2 on back-facing (inside-the-shell) hits, n = the Glass BSDF IOR. Front-face emission and every other channel stay as Cycles renders them
